purpose: Owner-governed bounded discovery mandates used only to refill an otherwise empty Research OS queue without free-form task invention.

frontiers.objective: Find exactly one causally distinct event/document mechanism using admissible public primary or documentary evidence, screen Legacy before freeze, actively seek disconfirmation, and freeze at most one CandidateHypothesis without reading candidate returns or future outcomes.
allowed_actions: read fresh Legacy ledger, duplication map and negative knowledge before ideation
inspect admissible public primary documents and event rules
map event clock, causal mechanism, eligibility, confounders and falsification scope
actively seek documentary disconfirmation
persist at most one frozen CandidateHypothesis and exactly one VALIDATION handoff, or persist NO_CANDIDATE
frontiers.success_condition: One Legacy-screened, causally distinct event/document CandidateHypothesis is frozen and handed to independent validation, or a durable NO_CANDIDATE result is persisted.

frontiers.objective: Find exactly one causally distinct fundamental thesis from admissible public company information, screen Legacy before freeze, include active disconfirmation and falsification, and freeze at most one CandidateHypothesis without outcome-driven tuning.
allowed_actions: read fresh Legacy ledger, duplication map and negative knowledge before ideation
inspect admissible public statements, filings, guidance and business-model evidence
map causal thesis, valuation logic, catalyst, falsification and confounders
actively seek documentary disconfirmation
persist at most one frozen CandidateHypothesis and exactly one VALIDATION handoff, or persist NO_CANDIDATE
frontiers.success_condition: One Legacy-screened, causally distinct fundamental CandidateHypothesis is frozen and handed to independent validation, or a durable NO_CANDIDATE result is persisted.

frontiers.objective: Find exactly one causally distinct forced-flow or institutional-constraint mechanism from admissible public rules/documents, screen Legacy before freeze, and freeze at most one CandidateHypothesis without inspecting returns.
allowed_actions: read fresh Legacy ledger, duplication map and negative knowledge before ideation
inspect public rules, institutional constraints, calendars and implementation mechanics
map forced actor, constraint, clock, affected universe, capacity and falsification
actively seek structural disconfirmation
persist at most one frozen CandidateHypothesis and exactly one VALIDATION handoff, or persist NO_CANDIDATE
frontiers.success_condition: One Legacy-screened, causally distinct institutional-flow CandidateHypothesis is frozen and handed to independent validation, or a durable NO_CANDIDATE result is persisted.

frontiers.objective: Find exactly one causally distinct quantitative/market-mechanism candidate from admissible public documentary or literature evidence, screen Legacy before freeze, and freeze at most one CandidateHypothesis without inspecting candidate returns.
allowed_actions: read fresh Legacy ledger, duplication map and negative knowledge before ideation
research one bounded causal market mechanism from admissible public evidence
map payer or forced actor, causal chain, expression, confounders and falsification
actively seek mechanism-level disconfirmation
persist at most one frozen CandidateHypothesis and exactly one VALIDATION handoff, or persist NO_CANDIDATE
frontiers.success_condition: One Legacy-screened, causally distinct quantitative/mechanism CandidateHypothesis is frozen and handed to independent validation, or a durable NO_CANDIDATE result is persisted.
